builds.name: Haymaker ceiling
builds.summary: Center Haymaker deals 160+(.25+.0025 AD[statFormula=2])*Grit. Grit cap is 50% max HP; Bloodmail converts health into AD, multiplying both axes. Armor penetration cannot help center true damage.
builds.goal: Center Haymaker deals 160+(.25+.0025 AD[statFormula=2])*Grit. Grit cap is 50% max HP; Bloodmail converts health into AD, multiplying both axes. Armor penetration cannot help center true damage.
builds.hypothesis:
Passive: Sett stores [100]% of damage taken as Grit, up to [(0.5) × Stat(12)]. Grit decays quickly [4] seconds after the damage was taken.

Active: Sett consumes all Grit, gaining a [100]% Grit consumed Shield decaying over [3] seconds. Sett then delivers a massive punch, dealing [80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160] plus [0.25 + (0.0025) × AD[statFormula=2]] Grit consumed true damage to enemies in the center (max @f1@ damage). Enemies not in the center instead take physical damage.
Heartsteel/Warmog/Titanic/Sterak/Shojin supply health; Bloodmail converts bonus HP and missing-health state into AD. Titanic is one Cleave family item. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers. Low-HP rune candidate uses earned Conqueror adaptive stats and Last Stand instead of inactive Absolute Focus. Test rune eligibility separately; do not assume every amplifier affects true damage.

Heartsteel exactly 500 earned HP if present; self 10% HP for Bloodmail. Seraph earned from fully stacked Tear. Rune gathering time fixed at 30min; item combat ramps ready. Absolute Focus is inactive at this owner HP; do not retain its stat bonus. Loaded form: owner 10% HP, target 29% HP, Heartsteel earned HP 500, Rod stacks 0, prior champion combat 5s, Gathering Storm minute 30. Conqueror exactly 12 earned stacks prepared before the scored hit; observe Last Stand eligibility per damage packet, especially true damage.

Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Heartsteel, Warmog's Armor, Overlord's Bloodmail, Sterak's Gage, Titanic Hydra, Spear of Shojin. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.

builds.name: Knuckle Down: enemy-HP punch
builds.summary: Explore a high one Knuckle Down empowered attack result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high one Knuckle Down empowered attack result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 Q adds 50 plus (1% + 0.03% per total AD) enemy max HP to each of its next two attacks. AD feeds attack delivery and the enemy-health coefficient; HP items indirectly add AD through Bloodmail. This is separate from W grit scaling, and two punches are not assumed to be one packet.
